title: Canonical ambient models for integral strict-system operations
statement: For a prime l and finite coefficient extension E/Q_l, there exist simultaneous derived strict-system operations o and canonical ambient models a. They give section-normalized ordinary/derived compositors, evaluated adjunctions with quotient transitions, canonical bridge to intrinsic semilinear systems, proper/open gamma with its lambda-adjunct and vertical/horizontal/base-change pasting, the tensor/exchange/projection square, the canonical ordinary limit and K-flat reduction-pull model, open realization L J M ≅ j! L M for every good M and J M with its displayed unit/counit normalization, and completed ringed tensor/pull/open/proper-open models. No finite-expression comparison is asserted.

source.place: Coefficient-comparison sentence; expanded strict-system realization argument of lem-sf-integral-compactification-system-realization

proof.text: Obtain canonical system operations, compositors, open comparisons, bridge and proper/open pasting from integralCanonicalSystemCoherence, retaining its left-adjoint tensor square. Use the existing integralReductionPullbackModel for the reduction/limit model.

Apply tensor_mate_coherence to the retained left-adjoint tensor square with the actual direct-image adjunctions. Its two sides are precisely properProjection/properExchange, so this proves ringedTensorCoherence before evaluation.

For Good M, normalized reconstruction inverts its actual counit. The open-reduction-normalized-limit theorem inverts the actual open mate at L(M) and the unit at J(L(M)). Form openRealization as inverse L(J(counit_M)), followed by L(openReduction_LM), followed by the inverse output unit. Cancelling these inverse pairs proves exactly openNormalization. The open invertibility lemma retains both Good input and Good output hypotheses; reconstruction of M uses its normalized part.

Obtain the completed ringed models and open comparisons. Define ringed proper/open gamma pointwise as the inverse open-adjunction transpose of ringedProperOpenLambda.inv. Naturality follows from naturality of that inverse lambda and of the hom equivalence. Applying the hom equivalence proves its adjunct equation. Assemble AmbientModels and its existential witness.
